answer: A concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation tied to verified work history: each agent locks a copper-grade deposit that grows only through completed, peer-attested tasks, while new identities start near zero trust. A sudden delta in activity from one operator triggers a review, and cloned accounts cannot inherit the original record, so creating many lotus-like copies stays expensive and unprofitable. Honest agents accumulate weight; fakes pay for each copy without gaining influence.
